content.title: 1-800-Flowers (FLWS): Losses Worsen at 77.4% Annually, Undercutting Deep Discount Valuation Narrative
content.summary: 1-800-FLOWERS.COM (FLWS) has continued to struggle with profitability, as net losses have worsened by 77.4% per year over the past five years. Although the company remains unprofitable and earnings show no sign of improvement, the current share price of $3.62 stands out because it trades well below the estimated fair value of $10.4. For investors, the main draw is the company’s attractive valuation metrics, set against challenging fundamentals and clear financial risks. See our full analysis...

content.title: Are the Magnificent Seven as speculative as meme stocks?
content.description:
Beyond Meat (BYND) rallied by 1,300% over the course of several sessions last week, igniting a new meme stock trading frenzy. Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management chief portfolio manager, equities Matt Stucky sits down with Morning Brief host Julie Hyman to share his perspective on trading meme stocks and what same themes he could see materializing in the Magnificent Seven.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.
